portal.historiesEyebrow: NEW COLLECTION · FIVE CENTURIES OF FAITH
portal.historiesBody: Billy Graham, Corrie ten Boom, the Elliots, and more: 18 real lives with context, biblical reflection, and sources. Articles in Spanish.
portal.heroSubtitle: Questions, devotionals and books to grow in faith. Free.
portal.aboutBibliaText: Eight Bible editions in Spanish and English, including Biblia Verbo (our own edition). Hebrew-Greek interlinear with original text, Strong's numbers, and morphology, to work directly with the original languages. Eleven verse-by-verse reference commentaries —Matthew Henry, Jamieson-Fausset-Brown, Keil-Delitzsch, Calvin, and others— plus church history, the Apostolic Fathers, extracanonical literature (1 Enoch, Jubilees, Assumption of Moses) with historical context explained, Bible customs, cross-references, and a weights, measures, and currency converter. All with a unified notes system to organize your study.
portal.aboutBuscadorText: Find passages by idea, not just exact word —in Spanish and English, running right in your browser.
portal.aboutLibreriaText: More than a hundred classic works of the Christian faith for full reading: Chapel Library tracts, the Apostolic Fathers, and classics like The Pilgrim's Progress.
portal.aboutRecursosText: Sermon editor with version comparison and Word export; nearly a hundred articles, reflections, and devotionals; complete Sunday school curricula for children and preteens; sixty historical sermons from Spurgeon, Wesley, Edwards, and others.
portal.aboutProyectorText: Free projection screen for songs and Bible passages during worship, with remote control from your phone.
portal.aboutIglesiaText: Share announcements and updates with your congregation through an invite link, no social media needed.
portal.mobileBody: Read, study, and grow your library from your phone. Download modules directly from the app and bring your study resources together in one place.
portal.mobileModulesBody: Open Modules, browse the available resources, and choose which ones to add to your library.
portal.mobileFree: Free, with no ads or in-app purchases.
portal.mobileImageAlt: Verbo for Android presentation showing Bible reading and module management
portal.aboutAndroidText: Verbo is also available as an app on Google Play, free, no ads or in-app purchases.
portal.aboutClosing: Everything syncs across devices without passwords, at no cost. Verbo keeps growing: new commentaries, works, and tools are added constantly.
portal.cardDesktopSubtitle: Your Bible library for Linux, macOS and Windows.
portal.footerTagline: Verbo — made for those who preach, teach, and disciple.
portal.quote: "Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid."

portal.questionsIntro: Salvation, prayer, AI, marriage and hope. Read an answer, open the passages and continue the conversation.

portal.questionsPrayerBody: When you pray and do not see the answer you hoped for: approaching the Father, remaining in Christ and walking without formulas or guilt.

portal.questionsAnxietyBody: A pastoral look at fear and exhaustion: approaching God without hiding your frailty or walking alone.

lumbrera.heroTitle: Songs and Scripture on your church screen.
lumbrera.heroLead: Lumbrera is Verbo’s free projection software. Prepare song lyrics and passages for a gathering, arrange the service order and control what the congregation sees from your Linux computer.
lumbrera.heroCaption: Lumbrera live: songs, service order, controls and projection preview.
lumbrera.songsTitle: Your song library, ready to project.
lumbrera.songsBody: Keep a local song library. Create new lyrics, edit existing songs and save changes for your next gathering. The preview shows how each screen will look.
lumbrera.songsItem1: Create, edit and save songs in the song library.
lumbrera.songsItem2: Arrange verses, repeat the chorus and remove chords.
lumbrera.songsItem3: Search your library and add songs to the service order.
lumbrera.editorCaption: Lumbrera’s real editor: lyrics, verses and screen previews.
lumbrera.bibleBody: Choose a Bible, browse books, chapters and verses or enter a reference. Select a passage and add it to the service order to project it when needed.
lumbrera.bibleItem1: Choose a primary Bible and an optional second version.
lumbrera.bibleItem2: Display two versions together, including different languages.
lumbrera.bibleItem3: Import compatible e-Sword, MySword and XML Bibles from Settings.
lumbrera.bibleCaption: John 3:16 with Biblia Verbo and BSB: two versions in the same projection.
lumbrera.importTitle: Use the content you already have.
lumbrera.importBody: Bring compatible songs and Bibles into Lumbrera and prepare their presentation in one application.
lumbrera.songbookBody: Import SongbookPro backups (.sbp and .sbpbackup) and ChordPro files (.cho, .chopro, .chordpro, .pro and .crd). Lumbrera removes chords to project the lyrics.
lumbrera.pdfBody: “From a PDF” extracts lyrics from documents with selectable text. Review the result before saving. PDFs containing scanned images cannot be extracted this way.
lumbrera.bibleImportBody: Import compatible MySword modules (.bbl.mybible and .mybible), e-Sword modules (.bblx and .bbli) and XML using Zefania, OSIS or Holy Bible XML structures. The text becomes available locally for projection.
lumbrera.backupBody: Import and save JSON copies of your songs. You can also recover songs from a compatible Verbo web projector backup.
lumbrera.searchTitle: Find lyrics. Add them to your library.
lumbrera.searchBody: “Search online” checks the sources available in Lumbrera. Choose a result, review the lyrics in the editor and save them locally. Some sources open your browser to continue.
lumbrera.searchNote: Search requires an Internet connection. Saved songs remain in the local library.
lumbrera.searchCaption: Real lyrics search inside Lumbrera’s editor.
lumbrera.churchTitle: Prepare the gathering. Support the service.
lumbrera.churchBody: For a service, study, rehearsal or church event: put songs and passages in the order you need, save the preparation and control projection from your desktop.
lumbrera.churchItem1: Save and open the service order to use it again.
lumbrera.churchItem2: Project onto a connected second screen, television or projector.
lumbrera.churchItem3: Change backgrounds and text size, clear the text or make the screen black.
lumbrera.churchCaption: Lumbrera in its light theme: preparation and controls for a gathering.
lumbrera.downloadTitle: Choose the package for your Linux system.
lumbrera.downloadBody: Lumbrera 1.0.0. Download the installer for your distribution from MEGA.
lumbrera.debBody: A .deb package. Requires Python 3.10 or later, GTK 4 and libadwaita 1.5 or later. Other Debian-family distributions must meet the package dependencies.
lumbrera.rpmBody: An .rpm package with openSUSE dependencies. Compatibility is not guaranteed for every distribution that uses RPM.
lumbrera.futureNote: Lumbrera is available for Linux. There are no public Windows or macOS installers yet.
lumbrera.overviewBody: Verbo’s projection software for churches. Prepare songs and Bible passages, arrange the service order and display the content on a projector or television.
lumbrera.overviewItem1: Local song library: create, edit, import and save lyrics.
lumbrera.overviewItem2: Selectable Bibles and compatible e-Sword and MySword imports.
lumbrera.overviewItem3: Projection and controls from a Linux desktop application.
lumbrera.homeBody: Songs and Scripture for your church screen. Song library, service order and Bible imports. Available for Linux.
